source_interpretation.title: Precursor aggregation persists through treatment
source_interpretation.text: The authors contrast loose initial sols with more strongly aggregated ammonia-precipitated suspensions. Microwave-treated suspension particles remain polydisperse; treated sols have narrower distributions and primarily hexagonal outlines. This is a morphological comparison, not a hexagonal-phase assignment.

source_interpretation.title: Do not merge XRD and microscopy sizes
source_interpretation.text: The table reports coherent-scattering domains separately from TEM averages. Initial rows report XRD <5nm and TEM mean4nm; their prose TEM ranges and optical sol size estimate remain different measurement contexts.

source_interpretation.title: Additional conditions are not a complete matrix
source_interpretation.text: Some experiments extend microwave treatment to6h without a sample-resolved temperature mapping; suspension CSD stays unchanged. The ordinary hydrothermal comparator reports a typical15nm CSD but no complete temperature/time recipe. No additional crossed variants or digitized distribution points are invented.

source_interpretation.title: Sintering suitability is a proposal
source_interpretation.text: The authors suggest that narrow distributions and weak interparticle contacts may help low-temperature sintering by limiting irreversible pores and favoring uniform ceramics. No sintering experiment or performance measurement is supplied.

source_interpretation.title: Sol stability mechanism is proposed
source_interpretation.text: Authors suggest adsorbed hydroxyl ions can stabilize the sol. Prolonged storage lowers pH to5–6 and accompanies coagulation; no storage duration or direct surface-coverage measurement is given.
